description: CPU-rasterize a .prt effect to PNG image(s): by default one contact-sheet PNG of 16 frames evenly spaced over [0, completion||duration], auto-framed. All builtin + embedded-PNG textures, all five blend modes, flipbook, stretch/velocity-align/flip, per-particle + connect-ribbon TRAILS, and layer draw order are rendered; DISSOLVE is NOT rasterized (a dissolve doc still renders its sprites). Deterministic: frames snap to the same 1/60 trajectory as simulate_effect. Returns image block(s) + a renderHash, the snapped times, the viewport, and the grid. An invalid doc returns validate-shaped errors.

doc.description: The .prt document as a JSON string.

fps.description: Frames at 0, 1/fps, 2/fps … up to the range end (max 240). Overrides `frames`.

frames.description: Number of evenly-spaced frames over [0, completion||duration]. Default 16; max 64.

handle.description: A handle from open_effect — use instead of doc to avoid resending the document.

height.description: Frame height in px. Default 256; cap 1024 longest edge.

layout.description: "sheet" (default): one contact-sheet PNG. "separate": one PNG per frame (same caps).

overrunSeconds.description: Render past the loop seam: extends the frames/fps time range to duration + overrunSeconds. Looping docs only; ignored (with a warning) otherwise. Explicit `times` already accept any time.

seed.description: Override the doc's authored seed. Default: the doc's seed.

supersample.description: Anti-alias by rendering at 2x/4x then downsampling. Default off (crisp, byte-golden).

times.description: Explicit render times in seconds (snapped to 1/60 boundaries). Max 64 entries, each <= 60s. Overrides frames/fps.

viewport.description: Explicit world-space viewport. Auto-framed from a bounds scan (+12% margin) when omitted.

width.description: Frame width in px. Default 256; cap 1024 longest edge.

name: render_effect

grid.description: Contact-sheet grid; null in separate mode.

renderHash.description: hex8 over normalizedDoc + seed + snapped times + size + viewport + bg — distinct from the sim statehash.

title: Render Effect
